The Antonio Circosta Law Firm is deeply committed to the protection of Human Rights, offering legal representation and advisory services at both national and international levels.

We assist individuals, companies and organisations in cases involving:

  • fundamental freedoms;
  • discrimination;
  • access to justice;
  • protection of human dignity.

Domestic and Supranational Litigation

Our work includes litigation before domestic courts as well as proceedings before international institutions and supranational tribunals.

We provide strategic legal support to ensure that rights enshrined in international conventions, such as the European Convention on Human Rights, are effectively protected.

Prevention and International Standards

Human rights are not only a matter of defence but also of prevention. We guide businesses and institutions in aligning their practices with international human rights standards, promoting responsible governance and sustainable development.
